sourceAdaptations: Translate all13 complete bodies; preserve Japanese examples/readings/forms/path/type/tags/JLPT and practical distinctions.
地理 field/area-layout versus map/land/dust;数学 not merely elementary arithmetic and not a standaloneする verb.
科学 versus理科/化学 keeps actual scope and homophone distinction without an English-gloss dependency or fabricated exclusive natural-science-only rule.
歴史 is a course of events/field, not necessarily admirable;文学 is literary writing/study, not every written list.
翻訳 textを/target-languageに/source-languageから; ordinary written translation versus oral interpreting, not mere transcription.
文化 social/group variation, no everyone-identical stereotype; historicalBunka proper-name use remains separate.
経済 economy/economics/finances distinction explained in Russian; broad character meanings remain memory aid, not invented history.
国際 compounds/国際的な, not automatic bareな or i-adjective; not simply a foreign country.
政治 public governance versus any management or medical治;法律 enacted law versus any informal rule or lawyer.
産業 includes service sectors, not only factories; remove Englishindustry/diligence dependency while preserving practical boundary.
技術 practical method/skill/technology versus any fine-art object, no Englishart/technology dependence.
Retain available source wrappers and unwrap unavailable optional navigation only; no source-only word forced into runtime.
unadoptedInferenceBoundaries: No automatic all-school-subject/science, research/activity, book/text/literature, industry/production or teacher/learner clique from category membership/cooccurrence alone.
No international=foreign guard merely because both involve countries; source distinctions retained.
No source-only腕/仕方/道具/昔/小説/訳す/通訳/理科/化学/規則 provider closure. Their outgoing negative edges apply when THEY are assigned, not as backward expansion of these13 roots.
No scientific-thinking=every native think/learn/teach verb from scientificcontext alone; no hostless suffix or writing/reading homograph merge.
Q1–Q5 Russian caption-polysemy proposals and Q7 archaic Japanese proposal are NOT endorsements as ordinary N4 teaching or proven necessary at modern frequency.
